rules.statement: A lessee who has been in possession for less than a year and a day can still bring a possessory action if they take advantage of their predecessor's possession.
rules.supporting_quote: "That decision was approved by Bonser C.J. in D.C. Negombo, No. 2,795, 10 and by Wendt J. in Goonewardene v. Pereira. 6"
